caption: The drawing depicts a small sculptural figure of a dog seated on an oval base. The dog has curly, textured fur depicted in shades of black and dark brown. The dog's head is turned to the left, and it holds an object, possibly a bird, in its mouth, which is colored in shades of reddish-brown. The base is oval-shaped and colored in a light brown hue, with a raised pattern of small round elements circling the edge. The background is completely blank and a neutral off-white color. The composition places the dog and its base centrally with ample negative space surrounding the central subject.
title: Statuette of a Dog
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
